notes.title: Reality Break has officially launched!!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone!![/h2]
Today, I am thrilled to release Reality Break, my sci-fi Action RPG Roguelite! I have been working on this game for several years, and it feels rather unbelievable that it is finally out. I started small with Evil Robot Traffic Jam HD, a tiny game that was an HD version of an even tinier game. Then, I created Sky Cannoneer, which was a bit bigger... but Reality Break is downright huge! It even uses similar cloud technology from Sky Cannoneer for one of its zones :).

In Reality Break, you're a mercenary who unwittingly becomes imbued with the power to alter reality and finds themselves thrown into a chaotic maelstrom where sinister forces attempt to stop them at every turn.

Use the Rewrite mechanic to change the fundamental nature of the gameplay: resize a weapon to fit your ship, upgrade items to unlock fantastic powers, increase the difficulty, add time to a ticking clock, and more! But do you have what it takes to stop those who know your next move before you even know it yourself?

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Brand new Rewrite mechanic that deeply alters the gameplay on a fundamental level
[*]Diablo-inspired ARPG gameplay with multiple interacting systems for deep build customization
[*]Opt-in roguelite structure inspired by Dead Cells that allows you to reset your timeline and unlock rule-breaking Talents
[*]Tons of loot to collect, try, and modify to suit your needs
[*]An evolving storyline full of mysterious adversaries and shocking secrets that transform the game’s very nature... eventually at your pilot's mystical whim!
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473060/Reality_Break/

If you enjoy sci-fi ARPGs, check it out and let me know what you think! Cheers!
~Courtney

notes.title: v1.2.0 Game Update - Multiplayer is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Corsairs![/h2][h3]I am thrilled to launch the second major update for Sky Cannoneer today, bringing local multiplayer to the world of Emoria![/h3]

[h2]Battle Games[/h2]
This first iteration of pvp comes in the form of local multiplayer via the new [b]Battle Games[/b]. In this mode, you and a friend can choose from all Techs, Superpowers, Forts, Boosters, and Summons, then clash with each other to see who reigns supreme!

And, while it's implemented as local multiplayer, the mode is designed to support Steam Remote Play Together for online pvp, including seamless support of multiple players on the same keyboard (whether virtually shared or on the same machine).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/38991e78143e0d63793bee1741b474db52998b10.png[/img]


[h2]Input Rebinding and Gamepad support[/h2]
This update also includes the first pass at an [b]input remapping[/b] system, allowing you to customize your gameplay experience. This extends to the brand new [b]gamepad[/b] support added in this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/ca7ad52e62016d95896eba29eb75dc81f26f46b7.png[/img]


[h2]Lots More![/h2]
As usual, the update also includes balance tweaks, polish updates, and bug fixes. Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1141570/discussions/0/3606765810648610587/]full patch notes[/url].

I'll be keeping an eye on pvp balance as well as making sure to fix any issues that crop, so let me know what you think of the new mode! Also, please leave a Review on the Store Page if you're enjoying the game -- it really does help. Thank you for supporting Sky Cannoneer!

To stay updated, like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/elementgamesllc/]Facebook[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ElementGamesDev]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: Multiplayer surprise and Weekend Sale!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Cannoneers![/h2]
[h3]Sale Weekend[/h3]First of all, [b]Sky Cannoneer is 20% off this weekend[/b]. The game has received multiple updates, including new game modes as well as many quality of life updates, balance changes, and bug fixes. So check it out! I would love to welcome more Corsairs to our Haven Battalions.

Also, if you're enjoying the game, [b]please leave a review![/b] And if you have feedback, feel free to respond here, post in the forums, or email me directly at contact@elementgamesonline.com.

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]Now, like I mentioned in the previous Roadmap Update, multiplayer is coming to Sky Cannoneer very soon. As in, [b]this month![/b] It will support local pvp, and will be playable over the network using Steam Remote Play Together.

I also have an additional surprise for you guys. The original plan was to start off with the basic gameplay and layer on the additional techs and other gameplay elements in future updates. However, after investigating the feasibility, I will be able to include full support for all of Sky Cannoneer's extra twists on the classic formula, with [b]all techs, superpowers, summons, forts, and boosters fully unlocked and available in pvp![/b] Here is a sneak peek:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/8ce224684c8dc99bdbe051ce447663240458b89a.gif[/img]

[h3]Thank you[/h3]I can't wait to get this update into your hands and maybe even [strike]get crushed by[/strike] play some pvp against you guys. As I mentioned before, this update will also include key rebinding, and I'm investigating whether I can get gamepad support into it as well, but that will depend on how everything else comes together.

To stay updated, please like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/elementgamesllc/]Facebook[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ElementGamesDev]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: April-June Roadmap
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Corsairs![/h2]
I hope you've been enjoying Corsair difficulty and Ironman mode. Has anyone beaten the ultimate challenge with both enabled? I haven't.

For me, it has been a busy time as I continue to improve Sky Cannoneer with some exciting new features for you all. Without further ado, here's a tentative roadmap for the next few months!

[h2]Upcoming features[/h2][list][*][b]Key rebinding[/b]: this is an important feature to get into the game, not only because most games should have it, but because it will support other features down the road
[*][b]Gamepad support[/b]: for players who prefer to use a gamepad
[*][b]First pass at localization[/b]: I'm starting with 3-4 languages and will build from there
[*][b]Ongoing[/b]: balance, performance, and fixes
[/list]

So, there you have it! Oh, wait, there's also this little item...

[h3][b]Local PvP is coming to Sky Cannoneer![/b][/h3]
This will include the option for Steam Remote Play Together, which helps me deliver a first pass at online multiplayer in a fraction of the time it would otherwise take.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/11e54fe7058a511e4547f3710e8c17fbe04b404d.png[/img]

This mode is already a lot of fun, and I can't wait to hear what you think of it when it launches. The initial version will be similar to the base game, without techs or upgrades, but the current plan is to expand multiplayer with full support for all of those advanced gameplay features.

Let me know if you have thoughts about how PvP should work in the game. I'd love to hear your feedback! In the meantime, I hope everyone is doing well during these unprecedented times. Stay safe, and stay Cannon-y.

notes.title: v1.1.5 Game Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Cannoneers![/h2]First of all, thanks for continuing to send feedback on Sky Cannoneer. I'm eager to improve the game and to incorporate your thoughts into each update.

[i]Quick aside: if you're enjoying the game and the updates, please [b]write a brief Review[/b] on the game's store page! Each review helps possible players know whether they would enjoy the game, and also helps me know what to improve in the future :).[/i]

[h2]v1.1.5 Update[/h2]This update focuses on a few Quality of Life improvements illustrated below, along with overall boosts to performance in dense combat, as well as a few balance tweaks and bug fixes.


[h3]Option: Show Entire Wall Grid[/h3]You can now visualize the entire wall placement grid at once, instead of it only appearing around your placement cursor. This is toggled in the Options dialog, Miscellaneous section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/2cd2d04db7305b3bf7d4556cb612265c76130305.png[/img]


[h3]Button: "Done Placing"[/h3]If you're done placing cannons or walls, you can click the button near the Phase Timer, which will move you right to the next phase as soon as your opponent is also done with their round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/aca50b4e86b5635ea245c623911ab04572ec1a6e.png[/img]


[h3]Fight Phase acceleration[/h3]And, in those rare cases where neither you nor your opponent can do anything during a Fight phase, such as when neither player has any claimed cannons to fire or powers/summons to use, the phase will automatically accelerate to speed things up and close things out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36210509/6eb5dde7b1c2637b82983f1e26560436e35c51e0.png[/img]


[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]As mentioned above, there are several other improvements in this update, so check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1141570/discussions/0/1867245431035214162/]full patch notes[/url].

[h3]Trading Cards[/h3]This week, I also added [b]Trading Cards[/b] to Sky Cannoneer, so you should be seeing them in your inventories soon.


As usual, let us know what you think of this update, and thank you for playing Sky Cannoneer!

To stay updated, please like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/elementgamesllc/]Facebook[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ElementGamesDev]Twitter[/url]!
